cohort: Newborns delivered in selected public hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of birth injury was 24.7%, with various factors such as maternal height, intrapartal fetal distress, cord issues, attendant, sex, low birth weight, gestational diabetes, prolonged labor, instrumental delivery, and night time birth being significantly associated with birth asphyxia or birth trauma.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery was significantly associated with birth trauma (AOR = 10.6, 95% CI: 3.45-32.7).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was significantly associated with birth asphyxia, but a general birth weight range for the cohort is not specified.
